summary: PRIMARY_SOURCE_PRIOR_INSUFFICIENT. Exact task, dispatch, intent, source identity, stop seal, and all 10 non-null local inputs passed preflight. The exact full Moreira-Muir NBER paper URL returned HTTP 403 and remained inaccessible; stop condition 4 therefore forces the insufficient disposition, forbids abstract or alternate-source substitution, and prevents a complete co-equal positive/falsification synthesis. The exact Cederburg et al. and Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu full primary PDFs were accessible, but no single-BTC DRA transfer conclusion was inferred from this incomplete three-paper matrix. The sole future label LAGGED_REALIZED_VOLATILITY_CONDITIONED_DRA_PARTICIPATION remains parameter-free and unused. Opportunity cost favors waiting for exact primary-source completeness over spending a future design slice on an evidence-incomplete transfer claim.
